spans.text: approved the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act this Thursday by a 15-to-9 vote, a bipartisan tally that sends the bill to the Senate floor. Senators Ruben Gallego (Arizona) and Angela Alsobrooks (Maryland) crossed party lines and joined the 13 Republicans, handing the
crypto sector its first major legislative win of 2026

The Clarity Act establishes a federal framework for digital asset trading, stablecoins, and intermediaries, splitting oversight between the SEC and the CFTC. Most of the market falls under the CFTC, while the SEC retains authority over assets that behave like securities.

spans.text: O dado em questão foi o Payroll: a economia criou cerca de 119 mil vagas de trabalho (acima do que o mercado esperava) mas a taxa de desemprego subiu para 4,4% (
nível mais alto em cerca de quatro anos
), sinalizando um mercado de trabalho esfriando... Ou seja, gerou uma reação mista e mais incertezas.
